title: Humanoid profile and file boundaries
purpose: Verify deterministic profile conversion, validation, a profile-valid PNG export, and re-import of that exact same-run artifact.

steps.title: Open the local studio
steps.expected: The studio loads in a fresh local browser context.

steps.title: Wait for the skin editor
steps.expected: The native humanoid skin editor is ready.

steps.title: Confirm the starter wide profile
steps.expected: The starter wide-arm document has no blocking validation issues.

steps.title: Convert to the slim profile
steps.expected: The document converts deterministically to slim-arm-64.

steps.title: Confirm slim conversion
steps.expected: The conversion is visible in the editor status.

steps.title: Capture slim geometry
steps.expected: Evidence shows narrower arm geometry without texture distortion.

steps.title: Convert back to the wide profile
steps.expected: The document converts deterministically back to wide-arm-64.

steps.title: Confirm PNG import is available
steps.expected: The user-facing PNG import action is visible and enabled.

steps.title: Confirm the converted document remains valid
steps.expected: Round-trip profile conversion leaves no blocking validation issue.

steps.title: Download the wide-profile atlas
steps.expected: A non-empty 64 by 64 profile-valid PNG is downloaded with the expected name.

steps.title: Confirm successful export
steps.expected: The editor confirms a validated download.

steps.title: Re-import the downloaded wide-profile atlas
steps.expected: The hidden PNG input receives the exact file downloaded earlier in this run.

steps.title: Confirm the downloaded atlas imports cleanly
steps.expected: The exported atlas round-trips through validation and profile detection.
